title: Launderlord - GTA Inspired Resource Management Game
author: SnooGadgets8326
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/rzqnuxmfw0yh1.png

  
I'm in my 40's and used to play browser based games back when I was a kid. Always wanted to create one, so I finally said what the hell and vibe coded one.

With the upcoming release of GTA 6, I took the inspiration from a few different games which I have enjoyed over the years. It's just early stages (early game), but I'd love for you to check it out and let me know your thoughts. I know it won't be for everybody, but maybe some of you can appreciate it.

I challenge you to get as far as buying the Laundromat and customizing your dashboard! Have fun!

[https://launderlord.com/](https://launderlord.com/)
